items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: Markets experienced volatility on the monthly expiry day, resulting in a largely unchanged ending. Analysts suggest that a decisive move above the 20-DEMA could enhance recovery prospects. While Foreign Portfolio Investors net bought shares, Domestic Institutional Investors were net sellers on the same day. The rupee closed slightly higher against the US dollar, attributed to potential intervention from the Reserve Bank.

items.title: Icra sees bank credit growth slowing to 15-16% in FY27 as rates rise
items.description: Credit growth is projected to ease to 15-16% for FY27, impacted by hardening policy rates. Fresh slippages for public sector banks are estimated to increase to ₹1 lakh crore in FY27. Private banks may experience fresh slippages amounting to ₹1.3 lakh crore. While banks' asset quality may deteriorate slightly, net interest margins should improve. The overall banking sector faces challenges amid these credit growth expectations and market conditions.

items.title: Stocks in news: Jio Platforms, RIL, Infosys, L&T, Tata Capital, Waaree Energies and Vedanta Iron
items.description: Indian benchmark indices saw a volatile session amid the Nifty and Bank Nifty monthly expiry. Stocks like Jio Platforms made headlines following its IPO debut after raising significant funds. Reliance Industries remained a focus as its financial results and fundraising plans were announced. Infosys successfully implemented a transformation project for Syngenta, enhancing operations and governance. Tata Capital reported a substantial profit increase, driven by loan growth and higher interest income.

items.title: Sebi may ease extra disclosure rules for foreign portfolio investors
items.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) is reassessing its strict extra disclosure protocols for foreign portfolio investors. These protocols demand comprehensive investor data from funds with specific asset levels and concentrated equity risks. Sebi aims to reinforce market transparency while averting measures that could destabilize the financial landscape.

items.title: Stock Radar: Bharti Airtel stock takes support above 100-weeks WMA; will it cross 2,000 levels?
items.description: Bharti Airtel Ltd recently found support above its 100-week EMA, suggesting potential bullish momentum. The stock is targeting a price above Rs 2100 in the upcoming weeks, according to market experts. After a vertical decline to Rs 1,917 in October 2026, the stock has shown signs of recovery. Analysts recommend maintaining a stop loss at Rs 1,725 to manage risks.

items.title: India in striking distance of 8% growth as reforms boost economy: Shaktikanta Das
items.description: Das said the BFSI sector has a crucial role to play in India's journey from a lower-middle-income economy to a high-income economy, through its intermediation in allocation of financial resources. He said the sector would be required to support India's next-gen Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), be the frontline of green and transition finance and become the catalyst for democratising financial inclusion to support this journey.

items.title: Credit card additions hit second-highest monthly level in 2026 as banks gear up for festive season
items.description: HDFC Bank and Axis Bank together accounted for nearly 43% of the net additions during September, adding 539,878 cards between them. The two private sector lenders emerged as the largest contributors to fresh additions, followed by SBI Cards.

items.title: Dynamic pricing's unacceptable in insurance, big payouts erode value: IRDAI chief Ajay Seth
items.description: IRDAI chief Ajay Seth criticises the approach of some digital platforms, warns high commissions leave less in the risk pool, push up premiums even as regulator seeks to build consensus

items.title: India's growth momentum stays resilient despite global headwinds: RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta
items.description: Reserve Bank Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta indicated that India's real GDP growth fell short due to external shocks. She highlighted that India has managed over 7 percent growth despite challenging circumstances in recent years. Additionally, Gupta expressed confidence that improved global conditions could enhance growth by another percentage point. She discussed the importance of diversifying economic activities to mitigate risks and emphasized that food security remains stable amid El Nino.

items.title: India to remain top of the Asian pie for Advent
items.description: Advent International has successfully raised $30 billion for its global buyout and mid-market funds. The firm plans to invest significantly in India, expecting healthy GDP growth in the country. With recent investments including Yatharth Hospitals and Aditya Birla Housing Finance, Advent remains confident in the Indian market potential. The new fund is set to target various sectors including healthcare, technology services, and industrials.

items.title: Adani Green’s debt maths: Why leverage may fall below 4x as capex cycle matures
items.description: Adani Green Energy Limited is looking forward to a decrease in leverage as its upcoming projects start functioning and yield cash flow. With a substantial ₹2.4 lakh crore earmarked for capital expenditures by FY30, the company aims to enhance its renewable energy capacity. As project loans are paid off, leverage is expected to dip below four times.

items.title: Infosys, TechM, TCS, other IT stocks plunge up to 5%, extend losses as global AI trade rebounds. What lies ahead?
items.description: Indian IT stocks fell sharply on Wednsday as renewed optimism around the global AI trade weighed on sentiment. Strong earnings from SK Hynix and Anthropic’s IPO filing fuelled gains in AI-linked stocks globally. However, concerns over an AI bubble persist, with analysts highlighting a potential advantage for Indian IT services firms.

items.title: TCS, Vedanta among 10 companies offering dividend yield of up to 7%. Do you own any?
items.description: Domestic brokerage firm Axis Direct’s latest report highlights companies that have consistently rewarded shareholders with strong payouts over the past year. A dividend yield is a financial ratio that shows how much a company pays out in dividends each year relative to its stock price. It is a key metric for investors, particularly those focused on income generation, as it indicates the return on investment strictly from dividends. Here’s the full list.

items.title: Weak domestic returns fuel India's overseas retail investing boom
items.description: Indian investors are turning to global funds as domestic market performance remains weak and opportunities abroad increase. A surge in overseas investments, particularly in AI-related assets, has been noted recently. Fund managers are launching various international funds to cater to this growing demand. Regulatory limits on overseas investments are in place, but tax-neutral hubs offer solutions.

items.title: Maruti Suzuki shares see target price cuts by Jefferies, Nomura, other brokerages after Q2 net profit drops 26% YoY. What’s ahead?
items.description: Maruti Suzuki shares post marginal gains despite a 26% YoY decline in Q2 FY27 net profit. Jefferies, Nomura and Elara Capital lower their target prices, citing weaker margins and financial income, even as record sales volumes and strong revenue growth offer support.

items.title: Subros shares surge 10% after securing Rs 1,225 crore HVAC supply order from Maruti Suzuki
items.description: Subros shares surged up to 10% after securing a Rs 1,225 crore HVAC supply contract from Maruti Suzuki for two vehicle models over approximately seven years. The award comes as the stock remains down around 45% over the past year.

items.title: 'Fully subscribed in 95 minutes’: Jio listing leaves with greater responsibility, says Akash Ambani
items.description: Akash Ambani, the Managing Director of Jio Platforms, shared these emotional words at the National Stock Exchange (NSE) listing ceremony on October 28, 2026, following the historic ₹30,213 crore Jio Platforms IPO. The public issue shattered records by becoming fully subscribed within a mere 95 minutes of opening, drawing roughly 1.4 crore applications and accumulating bids worth approximately ₹7.4 lakh crore.

items.title: Isha Ambani says Jio IPO marks a promise, renews Dhirubhai Ambani’s trust with investors
items.description: Isha Ambani described Jio Platforms’ stock market debut as a promise to honour the trust of investors and customers, nearly five decades after Dhirubhai Ambani took Reliance Industries public. Jio’s Rs 30,200-crore IPO attracted over Rs 7 lakh crore in demand, with the stock listing at a 21.3% premium.

items.title: Smallcap stocks rally up to 21% in 2 days: Should you chase the rush or book profits?
items.description: In the last two trading sessions, smallcap stocks have experienced an impressive resurgence, with certain stocks posting significant gains. As investors weigh their options, they face the decision of whether to capitalize on this upswing or secure profits amidst growing caution. Technical analysts identify critical resistance levels, foreseeing possible pullbacks. They recommend partial profit-taking at these points while also highlighting several stocks with promising recovery signs for potential purchases.

items.title: United Breweries shares rally 14% after Q2FY27 profit jumps 191% YoY
items.description: United Breweries shares surged by 14.44% as the company announced a staggering 191% jump in net profit, now at Rs 135 crore for the September quarter of FY27. Additionally, net sales increased by 24% to reach Rs 2,537 crore, driven by strong premium beer sales. However, despite this impressive performance, the stock has seen a decline of about 30% over the previous year.

items.title: No. 2 on Day 1: How Jio Platforms broke India’s market cap hierarchy in debut trade
items.description: Jio Platforms made a blockbuster stock market debut, listing at a 21.3% premium over its IPO price of Rs 1,119 at Rs 1,358 on the BSE. With a market capitalisation of around Rs 12.5 lakh crore, it became India’s second-most valuable listed company after parent Reliance Industries, overtaking Bharti Airtel. The debut also made Jio India’s largest listed telecom company, placing it ahead of major players such as TCS, SBI and Bajaj Finance.

items.title: Jio Platforms shares get 3 Buy calls on Day 1 as Nomura, Motilal and Elara initiate coverage. Check target price
items.description: Jio Platforms debuted at a 21.36% premium to its IPO price on Wednesday, while Nomura, Motilal Oswal and Elara Capital initiated coverage with Buy ratings. Brokerages cited telecom leadership, tariff hikes, rising ARPU, digital services and improving cash flow as key growth drivers.

items.title: L&T shares rally 6% after Q2 net profit jumps 33% YoY. Why Jefferies cut target price?
items.description: Larsen & Toubro (L&T) shares rose sharply on Wednesday after the company reported a 33% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 5,202 crore. Jefferies retained its Buy rating but cut the target price to Rs 4,700, citing weaker-than-expected margins and factoring in lower estimates.

items.title: Akash Ambani announces Jio’s next big mission after data: Bring AI, cloud and space connectivity to every Indian
items.description: Jio Platforms made a strong stock market debut, listing at a 21.3% premium after its Rs 30,200 crore IPO was fully subscribed within 95 minutes. Managing Director Akash Ambani outlined Jio’s next phase of growth, focusing on democratising artificial intelligence, cloud computing, space connectivity and emerging digital technologies to transform lives across India.

items.title: Jio Platforms listing at BSE: 'Will create value for decades to come', says Akash Ambani
items.description: Jio Platforms MD Akash Ambani said on October 28 the company aims to democratise AI, cloud computing, connected devices and satellite connectivity over the next decade, as it seeks to become a global technology powerhouse. “In our first 10 years, we democratised data. In our next 10, we want to democratise every technology that can transform Indian lives,” he said at the company’s listing.

items.title: Jio makes its D-Street debut: What it means for Reliance Industries investors and the road ahead
items.description: Jio Platforms’ stock market debut has brought its standalone valuation into focus, raising questions about value unlocking for Reliance Industries shareholders. Analysts weigh the outlook for Jio and RIL, the holding-company discount, and the growth drivers shaping their investment cases.
